purpose: A candidate research-method pack for one next paired historical Holdout. It records no validation claim and must be tested only through the pre-frozen paired comparison below.

predecessor.carry_forward_basis: V2 is the authoritative carry-forward for the first four settled Blind feedback episodes.

rules.scope: management execution, normal earnings, and valuation direction within the responsibility boundary whose scale is being credited
rules.trigger: scale, volume, revenue, capacity, store, customer, or deployment growth is used to justify an upgrade
rules.required_behavior: before upgrading, build a responsibility-matched bridge to recurring profit, unit economics, utilization, inventory absorption, or an equivalent economic carrier; preserve independently supported company judgments when one bridge remains open
rules.prohibited_inference: deployment or scale growth alone proves customer absorption, execution quality, normal earnings, capital return, or higher intrinsic value
rules.disconfirming_observation: later matched economics show that the withheld upgrade was warranted even though the responsibility-matched bridge was weak or adverse, and the pause changed the material treatment in the wrong direction

rules.scope: the incremental project, product, or capital burden that shows weak conversion; not every already-absorbed operation or unrelated management responsibility
rules.trigger: within one responsibility boundary, recurring profit grows more slowly than revenue, gross margin declines, and capital expenditure grows faster than profit
rules.required_behavior: retain already-supported enterprise strengths and execution credit, but pause any further upgrade for the incremental project or matched capital burden until recurring unit profit, utilization, or a cash-return bridge explains the incremental return
rules.prohibited_inference: the conversion triad, a scoped credit MIXED, or an unproven new project automatically proves enterprise failure, permanent loss, or withdrawal of already-validated product and channel execution credit
rules.disconfirming_observation: later matched project utilization, unit economics, and parent cash show that the scoped pause worsened the material treatment, or that the supposedly isolated weakness was already a material enterprise-wide loss carrier

rules.scope: management execution by named action and responsibility boundary, including product or channel execution, operating-cash execution, credit or financing execution, and incremental capital allocation
rules.trigger: different responsibility-matched management subaxes produce positive, conditional, mixed, or adverse observations in the same episode
rules.required_behavior: state each subaxis treatment before any enterprise summary; a local MIXED or CONDITIONAL signal may lower only its matched execution credit, while an enterprise-wide downgrade requires an observed material negative carrier or a demonstrated transmission into normal earnings, parent owner cash, or permanent loss; remove already-settled questions from the next rank-one research action
rules.prohibited_inference: the weakest local treatment is the company-wide management score, MIXED is equivalent to NEGATIVE, or a strong product result proves credit quality and new-project capital returns
rules.disconfirming_observation: a later material loss emerges through the scoped conditional carrier and shows that preserving positive credit elsewhere caused a worse enterprise treatment even though the cross-boundary transmission was already observable before the outcome

v3_vs_v2_summary.exact_disposition: All three V2 rules are carried forward byte-for-byte in meaning and wording. V3 adds only a post-V2 evidence ledger and a paired-Holdout evaluation contract; neither adds a research admission gate nor changes a pre-outcome company treatment rule.
v3_vs_v2_summary.why_no_rule_changed: Each direct post-V2 Blind receipt either explicitly reports no material new method utility or explicitly says no transferable rule was created. The feedback produced company-specific treatment and next-cutoff-agenda changes, but did not identify a change that would have altered another unknown company's pre-outcome treatment.

post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.observed_company_specific_feedback: Operating/customer absorption and group-cash-related credit/parent availability settled NEGATIVE; acquisition capital allocation remained LOCAL_UNKNOWN.
post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.rule_change_test: NO_CHANGE: the receipt states the frozen contract already required every relevant split and local-UNKNOWN treatment, so outcome did not add or alter a next-unknown-company field, threshold, or research action.

post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.observed_company_specific_feedback: Core customer absorption/spread and new-material unit economics settled NEGATIVE; growth-capex cash conversion/debt settled MIXED.
post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.rule_change_test: NO_CHANGE: the outcome used the already-frozen separation of capacity, customer absorption, unit economics, cash burden, and debt scope and did not change a next-unknown-company field or treatment.

post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.observed_company_specific_feedback: One channel leg was mixed while two product-bucket absorption legs and collection/cash observations passed, with financial-company attribution remaining local.
post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.rule_change_test: NO_CHANGE: the receipt says the direct-sales, iMaotai, and wholesale legs, product buckets, and collection-versus-consolidated-cash distinction were already present.

post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.observed_company_specific_feedback: Customer absorption and capital return failed while unit economics were mixed and the owner-cash proxy passed; the company treatment was downgraded and its next-cutoff question changed.
post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.next_cutoff_research_agenda_delta: From first-period mechanical comparisons to repeated product-volume/margin and same-definition ROE recovery without sacrificing margin.
post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.rule_change_test: NO_CHANGE: the four-axis separation already prevented cash or local margin improvement from replacing failed demand or capital return. This is a material company update, not a newly discovered next-unknown-company rule.

post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.observed_company_specific_feedback: Three frozen cells passed; the company moved from first confirmation to durability, coupling, and licensing/timing-effect tests while R&D remained required reinvestment.
post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.next_cutoff_research_agenda_delta: From first confirmation to persistence and coupling tests for the innovative-revenue carrier, cash conversion, R&D funding, and licensing/timing effects.
post_v2_direct_feedback_ledger.rule_change_test: NO_CHANGE: the receipt expressly states that no new transferable rule was created and that one all-pass company settlement is not cross-company transfer.

v2_carry_forward_provenance.role: Pre-V2 source evidence for V2's scope-preserving management-merge behavior. It is not counted as a post-V2 rule change.

paired_historical_holdout_evaluation_con.purpose: Evaluate this frozen candidate method against a fair ordinary-research baseline, not against a strawman and not against prose volume.
paired_historical_holdout_evaluation_con.freeze_timing: Before any Holdout outcome content is read.
paired_historical_holdout_evaluation_con.same_evidence_required: Baseline and Enhanced must receive the same cutoff-bounded, result-unseen evidence set.
paired_historical_holdout_evaluation_con.same_budget_required: Baseline and Enhanced must receive the same stated research budget, tools, and time/turn allocation.
paired_historical_holdout_evaluation_con.material_difference_must_be_pre_frozen: Before outcome access, freeze a specific economic difference between Baseline and Enhanced that could change normal-earnings treatment, owner-cash treatment, permanent-loss treatment, valuation direction, or the highest-value next research action. The difference must state its mechanism and expected decision consequence.
not_evaluable_if: no specific Baseline-versus-Enhanced economic treatment difference is frozen before outcome access
the cutoff, result-unseen evidence set, tools, or research budget differs between arms
the asserted difference is only more prose, more fields, more caveats, a lower UNKNOWN count, or additional gates
paired_historical_holdout_evaluation_con.allowed_utility_standard: Enhanced may be preferred only if outcome feedback shows the pre-frozen difference materially improved a company judgment or treatment for the stated economic reason. A correct local field, a passed validator, or a completed receipt alone is not utility.
prohibited_utility_proxies: more fields, documents, receipts, or citations
a lower UNKNOWN count or a whole-company refusal induced by UNKNOWN
more gates, a stricter gate, or a newly added global gate
price, return, valuation, or investment-action results

non_defensive_operating_boundary.localize_uncertainty: A missing or mismatched measurement limits only the affected proposition. It cannot be used to terminate the enterprise judgment or to credit defensive behavior as research utility.
non_defensive_operating_boundary.global_gate_disposition: NONE. This pack introduces no mandatory admission, evidence-volume, field-count, or outcome-settlement gate. The rules remain candidate research behaviors to be tested in the paired Holdout.
non_defensive_operating_boundary.company_specific_feedback_is_retained: A company treatment or research-agenda delta remains economically useful feedback even when it does not create a transferable rule; it must not be relabeled as a method failure or discarded as a non-result.
